mapper.select:
SELECT pc.*, v.name_zh AS vessel_name_zh, v.name_en AS vessel_name_en, v.imo_number AS imo_number, v.vessel_call_sign AS vessel_call_sign, v.vessel_length AS vessel_length, v.vessel_width AS vessel_width, v.gross_tonnage AS gross_tonnage, v.net_tonnage AS net_tonnage, voy.voyage_number AS voyage_number, voy.voyage_type AS voyage_type, voy.cargo_name AS cargo_name, voy.cargo_quantity AS cargo_quantity, ia.company_name AS inbound_agent_name, oa.company_name AS outbound_agent_name, -- 起始位置名称（根据类型动态获取） CASE WHEN pc.start_location_type = 'BERTH' THEN (SELECT berth_name FROM berths WHERE id = pc.start_location_id) WHEN pc.start_location_type = 'ANCHORAGE' THEN (SELECT anchorage_name_zh FROM anchorages WHERE id = pc.start_location_id) WHEN pc.start_location_type = 'WHARF' THEN (SELECT wharf_name_zh FROM wharves WHERE id = pc.start_location_id) WHEN pc.start_location_type = 'PORT_AREA' THEN (SELECT area_name_zh FROM port_areas WHERE id = pc.start_location_id) ELSE pc.start_location_name END AS start_location_full_name, -- 结束位置名称（根据类型动态获取） CASE WHEN pc.end_location_type = 'BERTH' THEN (SELECT berth_name FROM berths WHERE id = pc.end_location_id) WHEN pc.end_location_type = 'ANCHORAGE' THEN (SELECT anchorage_name_zh FROM anchorages WHERE id = pc.end_location_id) WHEN pc.end_location_type = 'WHARF' THEN (SELECT wharf_name_zh FROM wharves WHERE id = pc.end_location_id) WHEN pc.end_location_type = 'PORT_AREA' THEN (SELECT area_name_zh FROM port_areas WHERE id = pc.end_location_id) ELSE pc.end_location_name END AS end_location_full_name, pp.assigned_pilot_id AS assigned_pilot_id, p.pilot_name AS assigned_pilot_name, -- 关联最新的计费凭证 (SELECT id FROM billing_vouchers bv WHERE bv.certificate_id = pc.id ORDER BY bv.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_billing_voucher_id FROM pilotage_certificates pc LEFT JOIN vessels v ON pc.vessel_id = v.id LEFT JOIN voyages voy ON pc.voyage_id = voy.id LEFT JOIN agents ia ON pc.inbound_agent_id = ia.id LEFT JOIN agents oa ON pc.outbound_agent_id = oa.id LEFT JOIN pilotage_plans pp ON pc.plan_id = pp.id LEFT JOIN pilots p ON pp.assigned_pilot_id = p.id WHERE 1=1
AND v.name_zh LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.vesselNameZh}, '%')
AND v.name_en LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.vesselNameEn}, '%')
AND v.vessel_call_sign LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.vesselCallSign}, '%')
AND v.imo_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.imoNumber}, '%')
AND pc.submit_status = #{params.submitStatus}
AND pc.billing_status = #{params.billingStatus}
AND pp.assigned_pilot_id = #{params.pilotId}
AND (pc.inbound_agent_id = #{params.agentId} OR pc.outbound_agent_id = #{params.agentId})
AND pc.certificate_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.certificateCode}, '%')
AND voy.voyage_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.voyageNumber}, '%')
AND pc.start_location_type = #{params.startLocationType}
AND pc.end_location_type = #{params.endLocationType}
AND pc.start_location_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.startLocationName}, '%')
AND pc.end_location_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.endLocationName}, '%')
AND DATE(pc.created_at) >= DATE(#{params.startDate})
AND DATE(pc.created_at) <= DATE(#{params.endDate})
ORDER BY pc.created_at DESC
